chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Jameel, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, Allah honoured the believers with Friday, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) established it as glad tidings for them and as a rebuke to the hypocrites. It is not fitting to neglect it, so whoever neglects it deliberately, there is no prayer for him.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of Friday prayer in Shia tradition and the consequence of neglecting it?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Baqir (AS), the Friday prayer is framed as a divine distinction for the faithful and a subtle rebuke for the hypocrites, highlighting its dual spiritual and social function. The Imam underscores the obligation's gravity by stating that deliberate neglect nullifies one's prayer status, a ruling that has been central to Shia jurisprudence regarding the validity of individual prayers when the communal obligation is ignored.
